description: Source code for QQBot plugin slash command handler, including command registration, built-in commands, log file processing, and command matching logic.

classes.name: SlashCommandContext
classes.description: Interface representing the context of a slash command, including message metadata and runtime state.

classes.name: QueueSnapshot
classes.description: Interface representing the current state of message queues for a sender.

classes.name: SlashCommandFileResult
classes.description: Interface representing a slash command result that includes a message and a file to send.

classes.name: SlashCommand
classes.description: Interface defining a slash command with properties like name, description, usage, and handler.

classes.name: QQBotFrameworkCommand
classes.description: Interface for framework commands requiring authorization, similar to SlashCommand.

methods.name: hasExplicitCommandAllowlist
methods.description: Checks if the account configuration has an explicit allowlist for commands.

methods.name: registerCommand
methods.description: Registers a slash command into either the normal or framework command map.

methods.name: getFrameworkCommands
methods.description: Returns all registered framework commands for external registration.

methods.name: matchSlashCommand
methods.description: Attempts to match and execute a slash command based on message content.
